newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek drachma likely to rise vs Ecu in 96 - Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Greek drachma likely to rise vs Ecu in 96 - Citibank.

text.p: The Greek drachma is likely to appreciate by 6.0 percent in real terms in 1996 against the Ecu, implying the ecu/drachma will remain roughly unchanged in nominal terms, Citibank in London said in its September rolling forecast review.
Greek short-term money rates could drop to around 10 percent by end-96 on a lower inflation outlook helped by the hard drachma policy, Citibank added.
The maintenance of the hard drachma policy will help CPI-based inflation drop to 7.0 percent or below by the turn of the year, it said.

Three-month drachma rates will be at 12.80 percent in a month from now, 11.50 percent in three-months, 10.50 percent in six-months and 11.50 percent in 12-months, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
